descriptions./industries/bfsi/: AI for underwriting, servicing, compliance and grievance, engineered to be questioned and operated inside your environment, accountable for its output.
descriptions./industries/healthcare/: AI for decision support, care coordination and training that gives clinical and quality teams time back, with the clinician kept in the loop.
descriptions./industries/public-sector/: AI for accreditation, citizen services and institutional knowledge, engineered with procedural rigour and auditable from the first decision.
descriptions./contact/: Tell us the number you need to move. Write to connect@esmagico.com or reach the team in Mumbai and Bengaluru to define the outcome.
descriptions./blog/where-agentic-ai-is-heading-in-reg: Agentic AI is moving faster than regulated institutions can hold it accountable. An operator's view of why that gap decides what gets deployed.
descriptions./blog/multilingual-ai-customer-service-i: A bank owes every customer the same accurate, compliant answer in their own language. How to keep multilingual AI service quality consistent.
descriptions./blog/ai-in-pharma-manufacturing-and-qua: In pharma manufacturing, every quality decision must be defensible and reconstructable. What it takes to put GxP-aligned models into production.
descriptions./blog/ai-in-algorithmic-trading/: Machine learning can sharpen execution, and a firm stays accountable for every order. Where AI helps in algorithmic trading and where governance holds.
descriptions./blog/telematics-and-usage-based-insuran: Usage-based insurance prices on how people drive. Why the telematics data pipeline, more than the scoring model, decides whether UBI pricing is fair.
descriptions./blog/the-frontier-bake-off/: The leading models have converged for most enterprise workloads. Why model selection now matters less, and where that effort is better spent.
descriptions./blog/claude-opus-4-5-cheaper-frontier-c: A sharp drop in frontier pricing does more than lower the bill. What Claude Opus 4.5 signals about which coding workloads now make sense.
descriptions./blog/gemini-3-pro-for-multimodal-and-ag: Strong multimodal and agentic capability is different from production readiness. A production reading of Gemini 3 Pro and where the gap is widest.
descriptions./blog/building-a-golden-dataset-for-llm-: You can only improve an LLM system as well as you can measure it. Why a golden dataset of known-correct cases is the asset most teams underinvest in.
descriptions./blog/ai-in-portfolio-construction-and-r: AI can strengthen allocation and risk analysis, and fiduciary duty stays with people. How to augment portfolio construction with accountability intact.
descriptions./blog/data-governance-for-agentic-ai/: An agent that can read and send data crosses the boundaries governance exists to control. How to govern what agents can see and what they can send.
descriptions./blog/adaptive-reasoning-arrives/: Adaptive reasoning lets a model decide how much to think per request. Reading GPT-5.1 against the field, and how to govern a decision you delegated.
descriptions./blog/from-proof-of-concept-to-productio: The passage from proof of concept to production is a series of transitions, each with its own failure mode. A field guide for enterprise AI teams.
descriptions./blog/ai-for-clinical-documentation-impr: AI can prompt clinicians toward complete documentation of care delivered. Where clinical documentation improvement must stop short of coding for revenue.
descriptions./blog/claude-haiku-4-5-economics-of-smal: Most production traffic is high-volume and well within a small model's reach. The economics of Claude Haiku 4.5 and small, fast models in production.
descriptions./blog/small-language-models-in-agentic-s: Much of an agent's work does not need a frontier model. Where small models lower cost and latency without sacrificing the quality that matters.
descriptions./blog/operationalizing-ai-act-obligation: AI Act obligations only become real when they are engineered into the agent. Why compliance and engineering have to translate them into architecture.
descriptions./blog/claude-sonnet-4-5-and-long-horizon: Long-horizon capability opens new agent applications and raises the stakes of reliability. Reading Claude Sonnet 4.5 on the agentic maturity curve.
descriptions./blog/the-best-models-for-ai-agents/: An agent acts, holds state and recovers from errors, so general benchmarks select on the wrong criteria. A framework for choosing models for agents.
descriptions./blog/ai-nursing-assistants-and-workflow: AI can ease the administrative load on nurses. Where workflow support genuinely helps, and where it risks the vigilance that patients depend on.
descriptions./blog/knowledge-graphs-and-rag/: Vector search handles similarity and struggles with relationships between entities. When knowledge graphs give RAG the structure vector search misses.
descriptions./blog/notions-workspace-agents/: An agent inside the workspace inherits every document and permission it holds. What Notion's workspace agents mean for enterprise governance.
descriptions./blog/next-best-action-for-relationship-: A next-best-action system bankers ignore has no value. Why trust and appropriateness, more than model quality, decide whether guidance gets used.
descriptions./blog/claude-opus-4-1-for-enterprise-cod: Most coding work does not need a premium model. Which enterprise coding tasks justify the cost of Claude Opus 4.1, and which do not.
descriptions./blog/excessive-agency/: Broad permissions make agents easier to develop and far more dangerous when something goes wrong. How excessive agency becomes the blast radius.
descriptions./blog/ai-for-medical-record-summarizatio: A summary is defined by what it leaves out. How AI summarisation speeds chart review without silently omitting the detail a clinician needed.
descriptions./blog/measuring-agent-roi/: Tasks automated flatters an agent programme. Why cost per resolved outcome is the measure that tells you whether an agent is worth keeping live.
descriptions./blog/ai-in-mental-health-support/: A mental health tool must recognise the user in crisis from what they say. Where AI support helps, and the guardrails that have to hold.
descriptions./blog/gpt-5-in-production/: A unified, routed model decides internally how deeply to reason. What deploying GPT-5 simplifies, and the control it moves out of your hands.
descriptions./blog/continuous-evaluation-pipelines/: An agent that passed evaluation last month can be failing now. How continuous evaluation pipelines catch regression before your users find it.
descriptions./blog/ai-in-the-ehr-reducing-click-burde: Click burden in the EHR drives clinician frustration. How AI can reduce the navigation and data entry without compromising the integrity of the record.
descriptions./blog/scaling-agents-across-the-enterpri: Scaling from one working agent to many is a problem of its own. What changes on the way from a single workflow to a fleet of agents.
descriptions./blog/kimi-k2-and-open-agentic-models/: An open model for tool-heavy agentic work can operate inside your own boundary. Evaluating Kimi K2 and the questions a regulated enterprise should ask.
descriptions./blog/grok-4-for-the-enterprise/: A capable new frontier model tempts teams to change their default. Grok 4 through capability, governance and the cost of a new default.
descriptions./blog/monitoring-llms-in-production/: Traditional monitoring stays green while an LLM gives confident wrong answers. How to catch drift, degradation and silent failures in production.
descriptions./blog/why-small-models-often-win-in-prod: Treating the frontier model as the default is one of the costliest habits in enterprise AI. A trade-off analysis of frontier and small models.
descriptions./blog/ai-workflow-automation-compared/: AI workflow automation promises work carried across tools without human involvement. How the options compare, and how to govern what you automate.
descriptions./blog/long-term-memory-for-agents/: An agent's memory becomes harder to use as it grows. How retrieval and decay keep long-term memory from polluting the context an agent works in.
descriptions./blog/reducing-hallucinations-in-agentic: An agent acts on what it produces, so a hallucination becomes an action. The constraints that actually reduce hallucinations in agentic systems.
descriptions./blog/red-teaming-ai-agents/: Normal testing checks intended use and misses what happens under attack. How to red-team an AI agent with adversarial testing before it goes live.
descriptions./blog/on-prem-vs-cloud-llms-for-banks/: Where a bank hosts its language models is a consequential architecture decision, often made for the wrong reasons. A guide to on-prem and cloud.
descriptions./blog/choosing-an-ai-model-for-clinical-: The most capable model is not automatically the right one for clinical work. A decision guide to choosing a model for a clinical assistant.
descriptions./blog/llama-4-against-qwen-3-for-soverei: When AI must operate entirely inside your own boundary, the choice is between open models. Llama 4 against Qwen 3 for private and sovereign use.
descriptions./blog/hybrid-search-for-enterprise-rag/: Semantic search captures meaning and fails on a category of exact queries. Why enterprise RAG needs hybrid search to answer both kinds reliably.
descriptions./blog/ai-in-actuarial-modeling/: Actuarial modelling underpins pricing, reserving and capital. Where AI helps estimate future uncertainty, and where actuarial judgement stays human.
descriptions./blog/planning-in-ai-agents/: Planning is one of the most common sources of agent failure in production. How decomposition and re-planning work, and where they go wrong.
descriptions./blog/ai-in-remote-patient-monitoring/: Remote monitoring produces a continuous stream of readings from patients at home. How AI turns that sensor data into timely clinical action.
descriptions./blog/claude-4-and-sustained-agentic-wor: Sustained agentic work shifts the burden of a deployment onto the operator. What long-horizon tasks with Claude 4 demand of the team operating them.
descriptions./blog/ai-underwriting-that-survives-a-mo: An underwriting model that cannot explain its decisions will not reach production at a serious lender. What it takes to pass a model-risk committee.
descriptions./blog/ai-in-pharmacovigilance/: Every potential adverse event has to be captured, assessed and reported where warranted. How AI helps pharmacovigilance detect signals at scale.
descriptions./blog/why-ai-benchmarks-dont-predict-pro: A model can top the benchmarks and underperform in production. Why benchmark scores fail to predict how a model behaves on your real workload.
descriptions./blog/controlling-ai-hallucinations-in-f: A fluent, wrong answer on financial matters can cost a customer real money. The constraints that control hallucinations where a disclaimer will not.
descriptions./blog/ai-in-the-radiology-workflow/: Worklist prioritisation is the safest high-value place for AI in radiology. How to design it so it earns the radiologist's trust instead of eroding it.
descriptions./blog/ai-trade-surveillance/: Trade surveillance exists to catch market abuse, and alert volume can bury it. How AI detects insider dealing and spoofing without a flood of alerts.
descriptions./blog/reasoning-tiers-compared/: A deeper reasoning tier is not simply better than a lighter one. Comparing o3 and o4-mini, and how to choose reasoning depth against cost.
descriptions./blog/controlling-hallucinations-in-medi: A disclaimer does not make a false clinical statement safe. How grounding every clinical claim controls hallucinations in medical AI.
descriptions./blog/llama-4-mixture-of-experts-and-sov: Mixture-of-experts changes the calculus of self-hosting for sovereign deployment. Reading the open-weight shift that Llama 4 represents.
descriptions./blog/ai-for-investment-research/: Analysts distil large volumes of source material into summaries that inform decisions. How AI speeds that work while keeping every summary auditable.
descriptions./blog/ai-for-clinical-trial-patient-matc: Slow enrolment is one of the costliest problems in drug development. How AI matches patients to trials for faster enrolment and cleaner eligibility.
descriptions./blog/gemini-against-claude-for-document: Choosing a model for document intelligence is more than a capability comparison. A long-context decision guide weighing Gemini against Claude.
descriptions./blog/audit-trails-for-autonomous-agents: When a regulator asks why an agent decided something, the answer has to come from a record. How to log agent decisions so they can be questioned.
descriptions./blog/bias-in-healthcare-ai/: A healthcare model can be accurate, validated and inequitable at once. How to detect bias in healthcare AI and defend against inequitable models.
descriptions./blog/sandboxing-agent-generated-code/: Code an agent generates is code you did not write and cannot fully trust. How sandboxing contains agent-generated code before it executes.
descriptions./blog/long-context-reasoning-in-producti: Very long context opens new applications and invites a specific production mistake. What deploying Gemini 2.5 Pro for long-context reasoning takes.
descriptions./blog/ai-for-patient-engagement-and-foll: Patient engagement AI works by contacting patients at scale. How reminders and follow-ups can improve adherence without eroding patient trust.
descriptions./blog/explainable-ai-in-finance/: Explainability is not one capability, and regulators expect specific kinds of explanation. How to choose explainable AI methods that satisfy them.
descriptions./blog/function-calling-maturity/: Function calling is not equally reliable across models, and agents break when it fails. Where models differ, and why the failure gets misattributed.
descriptions./blog/generative-ai-in-healthcare/: Generative AI in healthcare is not broadly ready. A practical reading of where it is production-ready and where it still is not.
descriptions./blog/the-react-pattern-in-production/: ReAct interleaves reasoning and acting, and it hides a failure mode of loops that never end. How to operate the ReAct pattern safely in production.
descriptions./blog/llm-as-a-judge-where-automated-eva: Using a model to judge open-ended outputs makes evaluation scale. Where LLM-as-a-judge works, and where its verdicts quietly mislead you.
descriptions./blog/ai-personalization-in-banking/: Customers expect offers relevant to their situation. How banks personalise with AI while staying inside consent and conduct rules.
descriptions./blog/securing-agentic-systems/: Prompt injection is one threat among several facing agentic systems. The wider threat model a security approach has to cover beyond it.
descriptions./blog/dora-and-ai-in-finance/: DORA brings production AI inside operational resilience. What the Digital Operational Resilience Act means for AI systems in financial firms.
descriptions./blog/ai-for-patient-scheduling-and-no-s: An empty appointment slot is paid clinician time left unused. How AI reduces no-shows and improves scheduling with gains that hold up.
descriptions./blog/measuring-rag-quality/: RAG has two stages that fail differently, and one quality number hides which one failed. How to measure grounding, faithfulness and retrieval.
descriptions./blog/ai-for-regulatory-reporting-and-re: Regulatory reporting carries penalties for getting it wrong. How AI supports reporting and reconciliation with accuracy a bank can defend.
descriptions./blog/deepseek-r1-and-open-reasoning/: A model that shows its reasoning offers more than most organisations know how to use. What DeepSeek R1's visible chains of thought mean for governance.
descriptions./blog/agent-observability/: You cannot operate what you cannot see, and agents are hard to see. How agent observability traces the decisions you will have to answer for.
descriptions./blog/ai-medical-coding-and-autocoding/: Medical coding turns documentation into codes that drive reimbursement and reporting. How AI autocoding delivers accuracy you can defend in audit.
descriptions./blog/deepseek-v3-and-the-cost-shock/: An open model trained for a fraction of the assumed cost changes the maths. What DeepSeek-V3 and efficient open weights mean for enterprise AI.
descriptions./blog/designing-agentic-workflows/: Making every step autonomous makes agentic workflows less reliable. How to design them so determinism handles what autonomy should not.
descriptions./blog/alternative-data-credit-scoring/: Many adults are invisible to traditional credit data. How alternative-data credit scoring can expand access without importing new bias.
descriptions./blog/gemini-2-0-flash-agentic-multimoda: Enterprise AI architecture has long rationed the capable model. How Gemini 2.0 Flash changes the economics of an agentic, multimodal default.
descriptions./blog/ai-in-drug-discovery/: A model can narrow chemical space to a ranked shortlist of molecules. Where AI compresses drug discovery timelines, and where validation stays hard.
descriptions./blog/the-model-context-protocol/: The Model Context Protocol gives agents a common way to access tools. What standardising tool access delivers, and what it costs.
descriptions./blog/agent-assist-for-banking-contact-c: In a banking contact centre, disclosures are made live with no review. How agent assist supports bankers on the call without adding risk.
descriptions./blog/ai-underwriting-in-p-c-insurance/: Insurance prices different risks differently by design. How AI underwriting in P&C insurance improves pricing accuracy while keeping it fair.
descriptions./blog/multi-agent-systems/: Most tasks designed as multi-agent systems would be better simpler. When the coordination in a multi-agent system actually earns its complexity.
descriptions./blog/open-or-closed-framework-for-choos: The choice between open weights and a closed API is often settled on conviction. A practitioner's framework for choosing enterprise foundation models.
descriptions./blog/defending-agents-against-prompt-in: Filtering malicious inputs produces defences that fail. Why prompt injection is an architecture problem, and how to defend agents against it.
descriptions./blog/model-risk-management-for-generati: The classic model risk playbook assumes a deterministic model. How to extend SR 11-7 model risk management to generative AI and LLMs.
descriptions./blog/ai-symptom-checkers-and-triage-cha: A patient with symptoms late at night may turn to your website. How AI symptom checkers and triage chatbots route safely under clinical rules.
descriptions./blog/robo-advisors-and-ai-in-wealth-man: Once a system tells a customer what to do with their money, it becomes advice. How robo-advisors automate wealth advice within suitability rules.
descriptions./blog/qwen2-5-for-regulated-workloads/: Some of the strongest open models come from outside your jurisdiction. How to evaluate Qwen2.5 open weights from Alibaba for regulated workloads.
descriptions./blog/ai-in-kyc-and-customer-onboarding/: Every legitimate customer turned away at onboarding was ready to bank with you. How AI speeds KYC verification without false rejects.
descriptions./blog/agent-orchestration-patterns/: Coordinating specialised agents is tempting after the first few succeed. Sequential and parallel orchestration patterns, and when to use each.
descriptions./case-studies/cipla-global-training-acad: How PYZO Atlas became the foundation of Cipla's Global Training Academy, turning SOPs and compliance manuals into multilingual AI learning.
descriptions./case-studies/koita-foundation/: How Es Magico unified scattered digital-health material for Koita Foundation into one conversational layer, with answers traced to source.
descriptions./case-studies/indian-school-of-business/: How Prism screens applications for ISB's iVi programme, scoring candidates against ISB's own rubric so faculty review an explainable shortlist.
descriptions./case-studies/indusind-bank/: How IndusInd Bank turned presentations, SOPs and policy documents into interactive, self-paced video learning that needs no trainer.
descriptions./case-studies/samagra/: How Es Magico and Samagra engineered a voice-first AI assistant giving farmers crop, weather and scheme guidance without reading an app.
descriptions./case-studies/indiamart/: How Evio, a multilingual voice and chat agent, automates IndiaMART's marketplace and support conversations across sales, support and verification.
descriptions./case-studies/tata-neu/: How Es Magico engineered a gamified rewards engine for Tata Neu, with playable mechanics and configurable offers across a multi-vertical app.
descriptions./case-studies/epic-global/: How Epic Global generates compliant listings and migrates catalogues across marketplaces and continents on a modular, AI-powered platform.
